title: Nova Scotia Building Code Regulations (N.S. Reg. 198/2024 as amended; temporary-permit expiry/extension clauses)
sourceLocation: Province of Nova Scotia, Office of the Registrar of Regulations consolidation (unofficial consolidation; official version per Royal Gazette Part II)
notes: Section 21: temporary building/occupancy permits must state expiry date + invalidity conditions; term extendable in writing; tent/air-supported and temporary-occupancy permits renewable every 12 months. These clauses cover TEMPORARY permits only — no universal building-permit expiry or automatic renewal. No PDF shipped from this entry.
